title: Random Decision Maker - Choose Between Your Options
meta_description: Enter two or more options and let the random decision maker choose one. Duplicate lines receive extra weight.
intro: Enter at least two options, one per line, then make a neutral random pick.

sections.h2: How do I make a random choice?
sections.content: Replace the example lines with your options and click Choose an Option. Blank lines are ignored.

sections.h2: Do duplicate options change the odds?
sections.content: Yes. Every non-empty line is one entry. Repeating an option gives it more entries and therefore more chance of being selected.

sections.h2: When should I not decide randomly?
sections.content: Do not delegate safety, medical, legal, financial, consent, or other high-impact decisions to a random picker. Use it for low-stakes choices when the available options are already acceptable.

faq.question: How many options do I need?
faq.answer: Enter at least two non-empty lines.

faq.question: Can I weight an option?
faq.answer: Repeat the same option on additional lines to give it more weight.

faq.question: Are my options processed on a server?
faq.answer: The selection runs in your browser. Technical request data may still be handled by the site's service providers.
